cases.title: A given reshapes the triangle in place (was T20)
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». On «AB = 5» the triangle on screen is reshaped, not replaced: C does not move. The same after each «הציגו תצורה אחרת».
cases.before: At about 1 configuration in 3, a different triangle replaced it (points moved up to 17).

cases.title: Naming an angle leaves the figure where it is (was T23)
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». On the third line the triangle and M stay exactly where they were, and A1 is the angle drawn. «הציגו תצורה אחרת» still changes the figure, and A1 with it.
cases.before: The whole figure redrew on the third line.

cases.title: A circle touching the ellipse at B and D (was T27)
lines: B ו-D נקודות החיתוך של האליפסה עם ציר ה-y
המעגל משיק לאליפסה בנקודות B ו-D
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The circle x²+y²=9 with M at (0,0), touching the ellipse at B and D.
cases.before: The last line was not understood.

cases.title: REFUSAL: two circles, so it asks which (was T32)
cases.lookFor: The last line asks which circle; none is picked for the student.

cases.title: «היא עוברת דרך …» means the ellipse (book p1-8) (was T34)
lines: נתונה אליפסה קנונית שהציר הגדול שלה על ציר ה-x
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Every line records; the answer is x²/12 + y²/8 = 1.
